## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (94%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Sole class in the 90% conformal set [F1], with 0% invasive risk and dual-model agreement.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 94%, Normal 5%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0% | Strongly favors Benign; zero invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% target (90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset-level guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 48th percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical image quality, in distribution |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%) [F5], 2/5 Normal (top BACH_0071, 93%) | All non-neoplastic; Benign vs Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Top anti-invasive score (-1.09) [F2], but 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 9, 10) · context · Elevated infiltrate score (-0.75) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 6, 9) · ↓ invasive · Text-only anti-invasive score (-0.52) [F4]; caption check disagreed · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Anti-invasive score (-0.42) with 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 0, 2, 7) · context · Mean area 48 µm² (0th percentile) [F7]; size CV 90th percentile [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (n=132); removing top-3 risk regions beat random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); top concept **normal_lobules** (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is **Normal** parenchyma, matching closest neighbor BACH_0071 (93% similarity) and 2/5 reference cases.
- Region 6 intraductal score (+0.22) or 90th-percentile nuclear size variation (regions 0, 2, 7) reflects true atypia.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 4, 9**: Confirm benign lobules directly; top-weighted normal_lobules concept is unreliable (0/20 spot check).
2. **Regions 0, 2, 7**: Review 90th-percentile nuclear size variation (shape CV 8th percentile [F9]) and region 7 stroma.
3. **Regions 6, 11**: Exclude intraductal atypia in region 6 (+0.22) and pleomorphism in region 11 (score 1.02).
